question: Reliable sample
analysis_conducted: 2015–2025 auction labels; missing outcomes retained as missing; one source-anomaly date excluded.
decision_role: Prevents a model from learning artificial zero auctions.

question: Target economics
analysis_conducted: Skew, auction growth, calendar differences, stock scale and persistence.
decision_role: Supports robust historical baselines, transformed estimation, and multiple accuracy metrics.

question: Information boundary
analysis_conducted: Only prior-close data or known calendar information approved. Correlated predictors identified.
decision_role: Restricts deployable daily inputs and motivates shrinkage rather than naive coefficient interpretation.

question: Initial relationship analysis
analysis_conducted: Marginal, within-stock, annual, and joint associations for initial approved predictors; transformed continuous target.
decision_role: Separates stock scale from changes within a stock; not a forecast-selection test.

question: Feature construction
analysis_conducted: 99 point-in-time-safe derived features across seven families.
decision_role: Builds a common master panel; preserves variables for later empirical tests.

question: Feature role audit
analysis_conducted: Predictor, context, caution and segmentation roles; no feature deletion.
decision_role: Avoids selecting only on pooled correlations or optimistic IID p-values.

question: Forward baseline comparison
analysis_conducted: Historical forecasts and global ridge on the same eligible annual evaluation universe.
decision_role: Shows incremental predictive value over a deployable trailing-median baseline.

question: Specification and economic-family tests
analysis_conducted: History windows, penalties, sample sizes, targets/weights, ablation, placebo, drift and tail errors.
decision_role: Identifies persistent auction/calendar signal and useful target normalization; exposes tradeoffs.

question: Global model selection
analysis_conducted: 58-feature five-year rolling log-residual ridge selected within a 0.002 development-RMSE tolerance.
decision_role: Chooses parsimony among practically tied candidates, rather than claiming lowest error on every metric.

question: Architecture challenge
analysis_conducted: Interactions, hard splits and targeted hybrids compared against the frozen model.
decision_role: No tested replacement clears the practical improvement and paired-uncertainty requirements.

question: Reconstructed backtest
analysis_conducted: Train, validation and test performance for the frozen model.
decision_role: Confirms forward performance and clarifies that train/test periods have different regimes.

question: Stock-level behavior
analysis_conducted: Six selected securities with annually refitted forward predictions; 2015 warm-up only.
decision_role: Checks practical behavior and reveals unequal performance, without establishing universe-wide representativeness.

question: Daily prediction errors
analysis_conducted: Unsmoothed representative stock-years, selected near each stock’s median annual log RMSE.
decision_role: Exposes missed spikes that smoothed charts can hide; does not explain their causes by itself.
